gloss: wind ensemble club; brass band club

definitions.gloss: wind ensemble club; brass band club
definitions.explanation: A school club for playing wind, brass, and percussion instruments. One of the most popular extracurricular activities in Japanese middle and high schools.

examples.japanese: {吹奏楽部|すいそうがくぶ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}っている→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: I'm in the brass band club.

examples.japanese: ⟦{妹|いもうと}→妹：00573_imouto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{吹奏楽部|すいそうがくぶ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦フルート→フルート：04462_furuuto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{吹|ふ}いている→吹く：02445_fuku⟧。
examples.english: My younger sister plays flute in the brass band club.

examples.japanese: ⟦{高校|こうこう}→高校：01083_koukou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{吹奏楽部|すいそうがくぶ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{毎年|まいねん}⟦コンクール→コンクール：28795_konkuuru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}けて→向ける：02306_mukeru⟧⟦{厳|きび}しい→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{重|かさ}ねている→重ねる：02039_kasaneru⟧。
examples.english: The high school brass band club practices intensively every year in preparation for the competition.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{吹奏楽|すいそうがく}→吹奏楽：07535_suisougaku⟧ (wind/concert band music) + ⟦{部|ぶ}→〜部：00440_bu⟧ (club). Includes brass, woodwind, and percussion players; despite the common English translation 'brass band,' a {吹奏楽部|すいそうがくぶ} includes flutes, clarinets, saxophones, and other woodwinds.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {吹奏楽部|すいそうがくぶ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: to join the brass band club
- ⟦{吹奏楽|すいそうがく}→吹奏楽：07535_suisougaku⟧⟦コンクール→コンクール：28795_konkuuru⟧: brass band competition
- {吹奏楽部|すいそうがくぶ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧: brass band club practice
